name: kaizer
description: Kaizer for personal trainers: manage clients, build and adapt training routines with AI, and follow each client's progress from ChatGPT.

interface.longDescription:
Kaizer is the workspace personal trainers use to program and follow up their clients. Connect your Kaizer trainer account to work on your roster from ChatGPT.

What you can do:
- Find a client and review their profile, current routine, training status and workout history.
- Generate a new routine with AI, continue from an existing one, or edit a routine in plain language; then send it to the client.
- Adjust one exercise's sets, reps, load or RIR, and look up weight suggestions from the client's 1RM.
- Follow progress: training analytics, per-exercise progression, weight history and physical test results.
- Manage reminders, client notes and training plans (planifications).

Who it is for: personal trainers and gym staff with a Kaizer trainer account. Clients (athletes) cannot connect.

Limitations: every action works on data inside your Kaizer account only. AI routine generation runs in the background and can take a minute; you can ask for the result later. Deleting or overwriting data (routines, plans) asks for your confirmation first. Kaizer does not give medical diagnosis or treatment.
defaultPrompt: Which of my clients haven't trained this week?
Create a 4-week strength routine for Ana, 3 sessions per week
How has Martín's squat progressed over the last two months?

positive.description: Find clients who need follow-up this week
positive.prompt: Which of my clients need attention this week?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns a prioritized list of clients with expired routines, unsent drafts, inactivity and overdue payments, each with a recommended next step. Read-only.

positive.prompt: Show me Malena Pittaluga's current routine.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows "Bloque de hipertrofia": 4 weeks, 4 sessions per week, with its sessions, exercises, sets, reps and loads. Read-only.

positive.description: Check a client's progress on one exercise
positive.prompt: How has Malena Pittaluga's back squat progressed this year?
positive.expected_behavior: Summarizes the estimated 1RM rising from 62.5 kg in March to 84.4 kg in August (+35%), with training volume. Read-only.

positive.description: Generate a routine as an unsent draft
positive.prompt: Create a 4-week strength routine for Delfina Bengoechea, 3 sessions per week of 60 minutes. Don't send it to her yet.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates a draft visible only to the trainer and summarizes its sessions and progression; nothing is sent to the client. Generation can take about a minute; if it returns still_running, asking again returns the routine.

positive.description: Save a private trainer note on a client
positive.prompt: Add a note to Facundo Iribarne: wants to focus on deadlift technique in his next block.
positive.expected_behavior: Saves the note on the client's profile and confirms its text and date. The note is visible only to the trainer.

negative.description: Medical diagnosis is out of scope: Kaizer does not diagnose or recommend medication, so it should not be called. ChatGPT answers on its own and suggests a professional.
negative.prompt: My knee hurts when I squat. What injury do I have and what medication should I take?

negative.description: Buying products is out of scope: Kaizer does not sell or order supplements or equipment, so it should not be called.
negative.prompt: Order me a 2 kg tub of whey protein and a pair of adjustable dumbbells.

negative.description: Charging cards is out of scope: Kaizer only records payments already received and cannot charge a card. No charge is made and no payment is recorded; the reply says Kaizer can't do it. If the user names a client, it may read that client's payment status.
negative.prompt: Charge my client's credit card $80 for this month's coaching.

publication.release_notes: The plugin now uses a dedicated endpoint, /api/mcp/chatgpt. Removed logClientInjury. getClientOverview, getClientsTrainingStatus and getClientTrainingStatus no longer return injuries or medical clearance.
